notes:
When you add a background from the gallery while Settings is open, its confirmation window now appears in front of Settings instead of hidden behind it.

The licence under a gallery background now reads in your language, in the confirmation window and in My backgrounds.

macOS: Corylus is not notarized yet, so Gatekeeper may say the app cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified. Right-click (or Control-click) Corylus.app, choose Open, then Open again. Only needed once per downloaded copy.
